description.en: Palaeoloxodon antiquus: whole-organism living environment prop. Nominal1m art scale. NN1 adult male composite 152-E9/175-E23A, not a single complete specimen. 152-E9 broad crown interpreted under skin with modest rounded paired bosses, not the stronger crest of 175-E23B. Two long shallow-curving upper tusks. Skin hue ears flesh trunk and tail artistic. Forehead injury not transferred.
